header.name: Robot going for a stroll V12
header.description: Traced robot with depth and play: the limbs bow forward so the figure has volume, the arms and legs hinge at their middle joints, the tail whips down its length, the antenna sways and bounces, the eyelids blink twice a lap, and the body bounces on each step. Path from Quick Detail "Robot Path 2" (fd1878e1-ac12-4355-afee-3ebeeb07d4d9).
